answer: Enrolment books a ten-minute video call with three proctors drawn by the epoch seed, each bonded 500 POA. The queue hides duplicate probes: a face already enrolled returns under a fresh wallet, and any proctor who passes both forfeits the bond and voids both accounts. Mid-call he asks for a seeded object, a fresh vine leaf, then a paper falcon folded against the clock, so a recorded loop dies on the second request. A thousand clones cost $2,500 per epoch in labor, $10,000 daily, before any bribe a hidden probe erases. A bridge inspector taps the rivets himself before he signs the deck.
